answer: An agent economy resists sybils by growing each identity as a willow of continuous irreversible traces along a shared river of public interaction. When a new account appears peers whisper an unpredictable short challenge drawn from recent network events and require a coherent context-aware reply. Forging a convincing willow across many fakes forces the attacker to spend real generation cost on every identity; failing the whisper simply rejects it. This prices the living stream of participation instead of a one-time capital stake.
